population_definition: All built-in gym registrations; all Nemotron _step agent branches; dormant GeneralReactTask/WebResearchTask dispatch and exported unused scorers. External user-registered gym envs are open extension points, not enumerable repository verifiers.
classification_notes: Status describes actual integration, not whether a concrete specification fulfills the mapping deliverable. All46 scoring routes have composition/extension specs; no new mode categories are proposed.
Capability_gap rows also require source wiring; not_integrated rows need no proposed core extension. Dormant status is orthogonal.
No real verified traces is a validation gap only for implemented routes, not a missing capability. Unpatched observed real traces do not imply migration.
Existing prepared math API is implemented; remaining math semantics require source parity/comparator-policy proof. Historic docs proposal to expose this API is stale and not counted as missing.
Native source scorers on unpatched routes are native-only runtime, not hybrid fallback inside an implemented verifyit cutover.
Calendar is a task-owned deterministic ScriptSpec harness integration, not an IFEval capability gap; no new class option is required.
Inherited23 extension-strategy routes split into19 concrete existing-class behavior gaps,1calendar harness wiring case and3 dormant math parity-audit cases.

Eight additional opt-in cutovers comprise two Reasoning Gym routes, Nemotron MCQA, three tool-comparison routes, and two dormant exported QA APIs. Five have selected real framework traces; pivot and QA lack eligible trace links. Typed tool comparison intentionally rejects JSON boolean for expected integer despite source Python bool/int equality.

Structured-output policy is implemented entirely in a client dialect registration using existing json-schema grading; source XML/CSV parsing and tool extraction require no core extension. Fifteen selected archived links match pinned native and archive; four reach schema grading and eleven reject in client parsing.

Citation/freeform format rules are source-owned parameterized IFEval constraint extensions with ScriptSpec deadline orchestration; they are not built-in comparator coverage. Twelve selected real links match source/archive and reach actual child IFEval grading. Vacuous configurations and regex deadlines fail closed.

Standalone26 IFEval predicates and the pinned NVIDIA registry execute through source-owned IFEval extensions under ScriptSpec deadlines. NVIDIA runtime preserves source Python RNG advancement; deterministic language detection is a documented client fix. Missing historical hidden state is a replay limitation, not missing dispatch.

Dormant BrowseComp/RULER/STEM use existing core schema/exact primitives for raw external judge output; both GenRM routes retain the full source cohort runtime inside ScriptSpec. These five routes have fixture evidence only; GenRM training-loop initialization and archived cohort replay are not claimed.

Legacy math policy is the pinned source hybrid contract, not inferred solely from successful parsing. Ordinary parser rejection requires a real symmetric judge verdict; raised parser failures are unscored zero. All18 frozen archives match after correcting nested judge transcript extraction; previous missing-transcript reports are superseded.
